news.title: Broadcom agrees to expanded chip deals with Google, Anthropic
news.snippet: On an earnings call last month, Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said that for Anthropic, we are off to a very good start in 2026 in providing 1 gigawatt of compute from Google's homegrown tensor processing units (TPUs).
